The replacement can contain \ n ( n being a number from 1 to 9, inclusive) references, which refer to the portion of the match which is contained between the n th \( and its matching \) . Also, the replacement can contain unescaped & characters which reference the whole matched portion of the pattern space. The / characters may be uniformly replaced by any other single character within any given s command.
